Per AGENTS.md §17 (GitHub API Call Hygiene), all GitHub API calls should prefer the retry-enabled helpers that provide exponential backoff and rate-limit handling.; Transient failures (network issues, rate limiting, temporary 5xx errors) will silently fail and result in a less informative alert (missing the failing step name). While the alert still fires, diagnostic value is degraded during API hiccups. The established pattern is to use `gh_retry` for all API calls.
